title: Bounded follow-up after the VOF linear-accuracy test
status: Read-only recommendation; R13 outcome must be finalized and achieved AMG target checked before applying this conditional plan.
recommendation: If tighter VOF AMG solves reach0.001 but the phase-error plateau remains, one pressure-only0.1→0.01 replay is defensible. Add local diagnostic reports/exports to that replay so it also identifies where the remaining error resides; do not continue a blind inner-iteration/time-step sweep.

comparison_contract.baseline: R12 reporting replay / R10 original1ms10inner setting
comparison_contract.reason_for_VOF_setting: Return to original R4 value; keeping R13's0.001 would create a combined change.
unchanged: HRIC, dynamic substeps and source/BC settings
comparison_contract.discriminating_power: All310 baseline pressure solves achieved ratios0.04018–0.08008 after2cycles;0.01 should require additional work. Verify actual ratios/cycles rather than assuming the requested tolerance was met.

local_diagnostics.name_provenance: Native balance inventory from preserved R4 zero-step report audit; other physical fields already exported successfully by R12.
local_diagnostics.not_confirmed: DivVelocityImbalance was absent from the observed native inventory. Do not hard-code or rely on it.
local_diagnostics.adaptive_capture: Also preserve the branch's actual largest phase-error spike in the investigated0.605–0.635 window if its time shifts. Use distinct filenames; preserve the attempt.
local_diagnostics.calibration: At each snapshot compare cell SumReport(MassImbalancewater) and SumReport(MassImbalanceair) with corresponding native MassConservationErrorReport/dt. Record values, signs, units and mismatch. Only if they agree may the exported cell field be described as the native global error's spatial decomposition.
local_diagnostics.reduction: Per-cell imbalance is a mass-rate contribution when confirmed by dimensions/calibration; sum it directly. Do not multiply by volume again. Signed sums identify net error; sums of absolute cell contributions expose cancellation.
local_diagnostics.export: Use star.common.XyzInternalTable with setExtractVertexData(false), Volume Mesh representation and region input. Export cell coordinates, alpha, density, pressure, velocity components, CFL, the three observed imbalance fields and any discovered relevant retained fields.
local_diagnostics.retained_fields: Enumerate actual new field function names, presentation names and dimensions after retaining storage. The common-solver documentation specifies residual, correction, limiter and reconstruction families but does not prove a particular VOF prefix. Do not invent names.
local_diagnostics.unit_warning: Common solver [variable]Residual is documented dimensionless; do not treat its integral as kg/s. Corrections/limiters may show correlations but do not by themselves prove clipping.

volume_equivalent_diagnostic.definition: Q_error = native_water_error_kg_s/1000 + native_air_error_kg_s/1.2. Also keep water_error/1000 separately.
volume_equivalent_diagnostic.meaning: For the verified constant-density, fixed-volume, two-phase source-free configuration, density-weighting the signed phase residuals distinguishes net volume-equivalent residual from water transport residual. It does not rule out local pressure/VOF coupling.

interpretation_rules: If pressure tolerance is reached and both the native phase plateau and volume-equivalent residual materially decrease, pressure/VOF coupling sensitivity is supported; still verify gauges, phase conservation across the complete window and cost.

If volume-equivalent error decreases while the water-phase error plateau remains, global pressure-continuity improvement alone did not cure phase transport. Use the calibrated local maps before choosing another control.
If the tighter pressure solve produces essentially unchanged results, reject this pressure-linear-accuracy hypothesis. Do not try successively tighter tolerances without evidence.
If imbalance concentrates near alpha0/1 and retained corrections/limiters correlate, report that observation; it remains insufficient to claim an undocumented clipping mechanism.
Do not stop inner iterations at an isolated native threshold crossing: R12 at0.618 passed0.01% on inner3 then rebounded.
